- Cannot have consecutive underscores

- Start with an uppercase letter

Unicode has the `\p{Nd}` property for "Number, decimal digit" which includes digits from various scripts. We want one or more of them, with no other characters.

We must ensure the entire string is composed solely of these digits.

Thus, the correct regex is:


This matches one or more Unicode decimal digit characters, with no sign, separators, or whitespace, from any script.
